plugins.name: blast-preview
plugins.description: Shows what a destructive shell command would delete or discard, inside Claude Code's own permission prompt.

plugins.name: jira-tasks
plugins.description: /jira shows your open Jira tasks as a card in the chat, with their open PRs

plugins.name: pr-status
plugins.description: /pr shows your open PRs and review requests as a card in the chat: review threads, CI, conflicts, stacked PRs, Jira status

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: /standup shows what you did since yesterday as one card: GitHub commits, PRs and Jira tickets, with a button to draft the update

plugins.name: test-watcher
plugins.description: Compact card and compact model-facing summary for Maven and Gradle test runs; the full log is saved to a file

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: TL;DR card under long answers in the transcript
